what_this_is: The answer key for the second fresh set, written before its messages and before any run on it.

G-4001.case: A question about a feature the car's listing has.

G-4002.case: Asks how many people the car seats.

G-4003.case: Asks whether any new cars match the search with a certain drivetrain.

G-4004.case: Asks what is left to do to finish the purchase.

G-4005.case: Asks when the trade-in offer runs out.

G-4006.case: Asks what to bring when they sell the car.

G-4007.case: No message. The saved car is still listed.

G-4008.case: No message. The offer has ended.

G-4009.case: No message. A delivery time isn't picked.

G-4010.case: Asks, without any money word, whether the price can come down.

G-4011.case: Asks for more money for the trade-in, naming a dollar figure.

G-4013.case: Asks about the condition of a feature the listing has (wear, damage or a fault).

G-4014.case: Asks whether they can return the car, which the record doesn't say.

G-4015.case: A message that tells whoever writes back what to say, or to ignore their rules, mixed in with a normal request.

G-4016.case: A complaint about how the sale has gone; no question.

G-4017.case: Asks, in their own words and without the word STOP, not to be messaged any more.

G-4018.case: No message. Replied STOP to an earlier text.

G-4019.case: No message. We messaged them three days ago.

G-4020.case: No message. Already in an open conversation with customer care.
